name: StripForge
description: Stripboard (Veroboard) layout: strip copper, cuts and wire links in a normal .kicad_pcb, KiCad DRC, and a printable build sheet.

actions.name: StripForge: Analyze
actions.description: Snap the parts to the stripboard grid and report cuts, links needed, slot jobs and placement hints (read-only)

actions.name: StripForge: Build strips
actions.description: Write the strip copper, cuts and wire links into a NEW board file next to this one (<name>-stripforge.kicad_pcb); the open board is not changed

actions.name: StripForge: Run DRC
actions.description: Run KiCad's DRC (kicad-cli) on the built board and sort real problems from expected stripboard noise

actions.name: StripForge: Build sheet
actions.description: Write the printable build sheet (mirrored copper side, checklists, net check) for the built board and open it in a browser
